verdict.rationale: Discord documents bot apps that run inside servers (docs-1, docs-41), authenticate with a bot token (docs-4), and receive server events over the Gateway WebSocket (docs-10, docs-20). Application commands also let users invoke an app in chat (docs-7, docs-19). This gives a real path to a bot member that responds in channels. However, the AI behavior must be built or brought by a developer, and nothing in the evidence documents mention-triggered replies. missing for 10: documented message/mention events or mention-triggered bot replies, any first-party or directory-listed AI agent integration, evidence of bots being added to specific channels with conversational participation, independent/hands-on corroboration.
